interactions.name: version identity
interactions.trigger: Ask the installed binary what it is with `probierz --version`.
interactions.response: Probierz has no version flag: it refuses the option with status 2 and answers with its usage surface instead.
interactions.cancellation: The version form returns on its own; Ctrl-C is available at the prompt.
interactions.failure: The version request itself is the failure: exit 2.
interactions.recovery: Read the identity out of `probierz --help` instead.
interactions.evidence: media/session.cast at 0.000178–0.28415 s; observed exit 2; media/01-version-identity.png

interactions.name: help discovery
interactions.response: Probierz prints 48 lines of its own top-level help, widest line 444 characters.
interactions.cancellation: The stream is short enough to complete; the prompt stays interruptible.
interactions.failure: A misspelled flag on the same surface is refused with status 2.
interactions.evidence: media/session.cast at 0.49254–0.798845 s; observed exit 0; media/02-help-surface.png

interactions.name: subcommand surface
interactions.response: Probierz has no per-subcommand help: `--help` after a subcommand is read as a surface name and refused. That refusal is the observed subcommand surface.

interactions.evidence: media/session.cast at 1.00924–1.29068 s; observed exit 1; media/03-subcommand-help.png

interactions.name: invalid flag refusal
interactions.response: Probierz refuses the unknown option and returns status 2.
interactions.cancellation: The refusal returns immediately; no cancellation was required.

interactions.evidence: media/session.cast at 1.49776–1.7698 s; observed exit 2; media/04-refusal.png

interactions.name: exit status reporting
interactions.trigger: After each command the recorded shell prints `printf "exit-status=%s\n" "$?"`.
interactions.response: The real status of the preceding product invocation appears in the cast as text.
interactions.feedback: exit-status=2 after the version form, exit-status=2 after the invalid flag.
interactions.cancellation: The status line is a shell builtin write; there is nothing to cancel.
interactions.failure: A missing status line would mean the prompt never returned; every step reported one.
interactions.recovery: Not applicable: the status is evidence, not an action.
interactions.evidence: media/session.cast at 0.28415–0.28415 s and after every other command

interactions.name: cancellation
interactions.trigger: Type `probierz --wisent-reference-probe` and press Ctrl-C instead of Enter.
interactions.response: The pending line is discarded and the prompt returns; the product never ran.
interactions.feedback: A fresh prompt follows the interrupt in the cast.
interactions.cancellation: Ctrl-C is the observed cancellation mechanism for unsubmitted input.
interactions.failure: The typed command is abandoned on purpose rather than executed.

interactions.name: recovery

interactions.response: The same installed binary prints valid help and returns status 0.
interactions.cancellation: The recovery can itself be interrupted with Ctrl-C at the prompt.
interactions.recovery: The valid help form completes the first-success journey.
interactions.evidence: media/session.cast at 2.81543–3.0937 s; observed exit 0; media/05-recovery.png

accessibility.measurement_method: Measured from this run: SGR sequences counted in the raw PTY bytes, the same help command run again with NO_COLOR=1 and the two ANSI-stripped texts compared, the refusal text searched for a named next action, and the widest help line counted against 80 columns.
observations: Colour: with TERM=xterm-256color on a real pseudo-terminal and NO_COLOR unset, `probierz --help` emitted 0 ANSI SGR sequences, so this product does not colour its help output.
NO_COLOR: `NO_COLOR=1 probierz --help` printed 48 lines with 0 SGR sequences; the ANSI-stripped text of the two runs is byte-identical, so every state the help communicates survives without colour.
Refusal wording: the refusal for `probierz --wisent-reference-probe` names the next action ('usage:') in the same output.
Terminal width: the widest line of `probierz --help` is 444 characters, so the help does not fit an 80-column terminal and will wrap.
Input: the whole recorded journey is keyboard-only — typed commands, Enter and one Ctrl-C — and every state is emitted as selectable terminal text, not as a drawn widget.
State without colour: success and refusal differ by exit status in the cast (0 against 2), which the shell prints as text.
unknowns: Screen-reader behaviour was not observed: no screen reader was attached to this PTY.
Colour contrast of any emitted colours was not measured, and no WCAG or terminal-accessibility audit was performed.
Behaviour in a terminal narrower than 80 columns was not observed; only the emitted line widths were measured.
High-contrast themes, non-UTF-8 locales and alternative fonts were not exercised.
Authenticated and target-selected paths were deliberately not run, so nothing here describes the product's accessibility once a host, vault, queue or credential is involved.
